peft.standalone: iyi LoRA / PEFT Adapter ikeneye ibonetse Base Model. Kuzana i Base na Kwihuza i Adapter in i Safetensors Provider; i Ingano Bya i Adapter ni OYA i Ububiko Bya ngombwa Kuri Gukora
peft.description: Guhitamo i Byuzuye Base Model hejuru, Hanyuma Adapter Ububiko. A Adapter nyine ni OYA a Byuzuye Model. Base Ikiranga Mugomba Guhuza i Adapter Iboneza.
peft.estimate: CPU ku 2,048 tokens. Gusubiramo kubara kugirango i ki/ bishaje Porogaramu na Imvugiro ku Itangira...

noInstalledModels: Nta mashusho yagaragaye muri iyi kategoriya.
limitedSupport: Ibikoresho, ishusho n'amajwi ntibyabonetse mu buryo bwikora - shyiramo imisusire ku buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga kandi ushyiramo imisusire ku misusire.
mlxExperimental: Ubufasha bwa MLX ari bwo gukoresha. Inyandiko zikoreshwa mu kumenya sihari, ikiboko cyo gufata inama ntibishyizwe mu buryo bw'ibanze, kandi ibindi bikoresho bya modeli by'ubu byashobora kutagira ubushobozi bwo kugira. Reka ibibazo kuri GitHub kugira ngo dushobore kubikoresha mu byo twakoresha cyane.
engineBundled: Imodoka y'inkoranyamagambo igizwe na Novera, bityo nta kintu na kimwe gikeneye gukwirakwizwa cyangwa gukosorwa. Cite this version when reporting a model that fails to load.
engineOtherVersion: Niba ukeneye iyindi versiyo ya llama.cpp? Gukoresha llama-server yawe bwite no kuyishyiramo nk'umutangabikorwa usanzwe ukora OpenAI.
refreshModelsError: Umutanga agomba kuba afite urufunguzo rwa base URL n'irindi API rwahinduwe kugirango abone amashusho.
noNewModels: Nta mashusho mashya yabonetse. Amashusho yose yabonetse yamaze gushyirwamo.
refreshModelsFailed: Gukuraho amadosiye y'amashusho bivuye kuri {{provider}} byanze bikunze. Kanda kuri API na base URL.
embeddingModelsDesc: Byakoreshejwe kugirango RAG na gushakisha vector. i Model Byahiswemo ni i Mburabuzi Ryari: Kurema
importedTooltip: Iyinjiza yavuye kuri dosiye isanzwe. Gukuraho dosiye yavuye kuri Novera ntizakuraho dosiye kuri diski.
importModelError: Kugirango ufungure iyi dosiye ugomba kuba ufite konti.
noModelFoundDesc: Imodoka zihariye zizagaragara hano.Niba utari ufite izindi modoka, ujye ku rubuga rw’ikoranabuhanga kugira ngo uyishyireho.
noModelFoundRemoteDesc: Imodoka zihariye zizagaragara muri uru rutonde. Ukoresha ibuto ry'isubiramo hejuru kugirango ubone imodoka zihariye, cyangwa ukoresha ibuto rya + kugirango ushyiremo imwe.

addModel.title: Gushyiramo umurongo mushya
addModel.modelExistsDesc: Niba ushaka ibindi bikoresho, kanda kuri ID.

deleteModel.choiceDescription: Guhitamo uburyo bwo gukura uyu mukinnyi kuri Novera.
deleteModel.keepFilesDescription: Gukuraho ishusho yo mu rutonde no gusiga inyandiko zayo ku diski. Ushobora kuyishyiramo ukundi.
deleteModel.permanentDescription: Gusiba ishusho n'ibifashijwemo na Novera ku diski. Ibi ntibishobora gusubiramo.
deleteModel.permanentImportedDescription: Gusiba kandi ifile GGUF ikomeye ku ibirindiro byayo bya mbere. Amadosiye y'ifashayobora y'imbere asigaye. Ibi ntibyahindurwa.
deleteModel.removedSuccess: Ubwoko {{modelId}} bwaciwe muri Novera. Amadosiye yayo yafashwe.
deleteModel.title: Gukuraho Icyitegererezo: {{modelId}}

deleteModel.importedDescription: Gukuraho uyu murongo wa importwe kuva kuri Novera? Idosiye yawe yo kuri diski ntizacibwa.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.azureDescription: Umurongo wa nyuma wa Azure OpenAI. Gusimbura YOUR-RESOURCE-NAME n'izina ryawe rya Azure.
baseUrl.alibabaDescription: Ukoresha umurongo w'inyuma w'ibiro byawe bya Alibaba Cloud n'akarere. Gusimbura YOUR-WORKSPACE-ID n'ibiro byawe bya Alibaba Cloud ID n'ukoresha akadomo ka API k'ibiro byawe bya Alibaba Cloud.

apiKeys.title: API key
apiKeys.description: Injiza urufunguzo rwawe API. Ushobora kongeraho urufunguzo rurenze rumwe mu Igezweho, na Novera izagerageza urufunguzo rukurikira mu buryo bwikora iyo urufunguzo rudakora.
apiKeys.testHint: Igenzura /models na buri kanda kandi igaragaza imiterere ya buri kanda.
apiKeys.oneKeyHint: Utubuto tw'isubiramo dushobora gushyirwaho muri Advanced.
